audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Darius levels 1 and 2 and Skill at level 3, while whys[0]-[2] on the same entry say 'Teemo's Q blind and range shut down your Hemorrhage autos at level 1, so he wins the opener', 'At two his W speed keeps him kiting outside your reach' and 'At three he still out-pokes you until your pull comes online'. content.early says 'Levels 1-3 Teemo owns you'. whys[5] calls first item 'even' while the chart cell says Darius.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 680 range and Apprehend is 535 — Darius has no way to touch Teemo before level 3, and even then the pull is shorter than the poke. The Darius packet chart (Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Darius, Skill, Darius, Darius) and the Teemo-side packet chart (Teemo x6, Skill) agree on levels 1-3, and both sides' whys describe Teemo winning those three stages.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 2 and 3 flipped to Teemo in both layers as one group, with ratings dropped to match. Stages 4-7 left alone — the two packets genuinely disagree there and I would not guess (see questionsForUser). whys[4] and whys[5] rewritten so the prose stops contradicting the chart cells it sits beside.
sources: internal contradiction with whys[0]-[2] and content.early

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 phase text carries the LaTeX fragment 'R = d + a \times Stacks'. whys[4] sits under the Level 6 stage but reads 'At 5 your stacked bleed and W slow keep him pinned once you've caught him' — it never mentions the ultimate. spikes and phases refer to 'Blinding Dart online' and 'first item' as spikes with no numbers.
audit.why: The Level 6 stage has to record the ult, and this one records level 5 instead. Blinding Dart is also not a spike at all: it is a flat 7 seconds at every rank, so ranking it changes nothing and there is no 'Blinding Dart online' timing after level 1. Teemo's real stage changes are level 6 mushroom coverage and his first item.
audit.corrected: Plain-language Level 6 text tied to Noxian Guillotine, whys[4] rewritten to describe level 6, and the flat 7s cooldown stated wherever the entry treats the blind as scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry treats Blinding Dart as an all-in answer ('Negates your autos', 'Catch him without his blind and execute') and never says what the blind does not stop. Move Quick is described only as 'W speed'. No range appears anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text blinds the target — it removes basic attacks, so it eats Crippling Strike's payload and your auto-driven Hemorrhage stacking, but Decimate still swings, still applies Hemorrhage and still heals off the outer blade. Move Quick is the bigger miss: its passive move speed lasts 'until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret', so a single landed hit strips the speed that keeps him out of pull range. Nothing in this entry tells the player that.
audit.corrected: Blind stated as an auto-attack answer only; Move Quick's strip-on-hit written into the phases, breakdown.early, whys and spikes.
sources: audits/top/teemo__darius.json (same reading of the blind from the other side)

audit.whatIsWrong: Guerrilla Warfare is never mentioned. The entry says 'Drop line-of-sight in bushes' as if brush were yours to use.
audit.why: Riot's text: Teemo turns invisible standing still, and inside brush he can move while invisible. Brush is his tool in this matchup, not yours — facechecking it is how a Darius eats a free poke rotation and lands on a shroom.
audit.corrected: Added to report[11] Common Mistakes, wants.foe[2] and content.late.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] Itemization prescribes Plated Steelcaps while content.spikes[3] and whys[6] both say Merc treads.
audit.why: Blinding Dart, Toxic Shot and Noxious Trap are all magic damage, so armour boots do nothing here — and the two layers currently give the player opposite instructions.
audit.corrected: Mercury's Treads in the full layer too, with the reason stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns calls Blinding Dart 'matchup-defining' with no number and gives Apprehend only 'Long early cooldown'.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 7s flat and Move Quick is 14s; Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 falling to 16s. Those three numbers are the whole timing of the lane.

notes: Kit-flag false positive: teemo.json derives 'knockup' on R Noxious Trap. Riot's text is a slow plus damage over time — no displacement. The _missing entry 'Both sides carry displacement (Apprehend (E) vs Noxious Trap (R))' rests on that flag and was NOT written into the matchup. The Teemo-side audit reached the same conclusion independently. Win-rate mismatch: the Darius packet reports 50.13% over 2348 games; the Teemo packet reports the same matchup at 56.9% over 1443 games. The two tables do not sum to 100 and were sampled differently — the level-chart disagreement at stages 4-7 follows directly from it. breakdown.wave and breakdown.trading carry the shared PDF-extraction run-on ('Key Mechanical Cooldowns ... How Darius Wins Trades'); left untouched, same as on garen, gnar, riven and rumble. The Teemo-side entry writes 'Liandry's Angueur' in several places where the full layer writes 'Liandry's Torment' — a repo-wide find/replace worth running, flagged by the Teemo auditor too.
